forbidden_claims: A named third-party payment provider is confirmed globally unavailable.
Inventory or database failure caused the payment error.
The customer was charged despite the failed payment.

causal_chain: The scenario runner enables payment_error with an error rate of 1.0.
Checkout reaches payment-service after inventory reservation succeeds.
payment-service emits PAYMENT_GATEWAY_ERROR and returns HTTP 500.
The checkout request propagates the payment failure to the caller.
root_cause.summary: The payment_error fault forces payment-service to return PAYMENT_GATEWAY_ERROR during checkout.
